signal: Unchanged RM1a and original SM1 eligibility, same fixed cohort; independent Decimal OLS plus separate deterministic rank selection
budget: Each selected name targets 1% of post-cost hypothetical account NAV; at most ten names and two per archived sector. Unused slots cash; no leverage, cash interest zero. Monthly targets, not drift caps.
accounting: Fractional adjusted-price proxy units, never broker shares; daily close marks. Self-financing absolute turnover costs, sales and purchases charged. No forced terminal sale. Missing held or target price halts, never fills forward. Corporate-action ambiguity blocks upstream; this ledger cannot value rights or cash entitlements.
event_store: Exclusive append-only numbered events, previous-event SHA256 chain, replay verifies all hashes and recomputes every state. HALT terminal. Source receipt hash and rank-plan hash recorded per event; hashes bind evidence but do not certify source authenticity.
rehearsal: Reuse previously exposed 2026 RV1a source snapshots and archived formations only; test selected targets and ledger against independent checks. Rehearsal is not a new backtest, no new return headline or parameter search.
prospective_activation: Still blocked until RF1 missing inputs, identity/action checks, timestamped rank seal and closed formation requirements are satisfied. No prospective ingestion or scheduler enabled by this PR; old dates are always rehearsal.

prospective_evaluation_registration.execution_lag: Second later XNYS session close; input/rank seal before that session opens. Calendar must be verified before activation.
prospective_evaluation_registration.comparators: Parent ordinary, matched ordinary, matched relative, matched residual; each independent 100000 account with identical 10% budget and 5/25bp costs
prospective_evaluation_registration.incomplete: Any skipped cycle, unresolved identity, missing factor/price, unsealed rank or ledger halt => INCOMPLETE; never extend dates to replace a skipped cycle
prospective_evaluation_registration.research_screen: After all six cycles and terminal mark, at both costs residual net return >0 and >matched ordinary, daily account drawdown <=5% and <=matched ordinary. Report all four controls, including unrestricted parent; retain prior full-exposure FAIL. These administrative criteria are not significance tests or guaranteed risk limits.
prospective_evaluation_registration.stock_intervals: Report positive gross stock intervals descriptively with repeated-name dependence; not broker win rate, no frequency pass gate
prospective_evaluation_registration.promotion: No automatic Paper or live promotion even on PASS; operational identity/fill/account checks require separate review. Six cycles cannot establish durable alpha.

restrictions: All preexisting tracked files and 156 core files unchanged; raw prices, factors and per-name ledgers private work/; no SOXL, paid data, broker reads/writes, or orders.
